programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle"
programmes.episode: USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle
programmes.desc: We reveal eye-witness intelligence on the USS Zumwalt, America's ultra-hi tech, four billion dollar guided missile destroyer. Learn more about the British firm who've developed Minerva, an ingenious, low-cost but realistic tank simulator.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programmes.episode: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
programmes.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programmes.episode: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programmes.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programmes.episode: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programmes.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programmes.episode: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programmes.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
programmes.desc: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
programmes.episode: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programmes.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programmes.episode: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programmes.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programmes.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
programmes.desc: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

programmes.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Fuel for Destruction"
programmes.desc: The atomic age introduces powerful rockets and nuclear energy, balancing technological advancement with threats like the Chernobyl disaster.

programmes.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Golden Age of Science"
programmes.desc: Military funding drives a boom in earth sciences and biological research, creating advanced weapons alongside deeper insights into our world.

programmes.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Information Is Power"
programmes.desc: Cold War secrecy accelerates spy tech, satellite surveillance, and early computer networks, laying the foundation for modern global communications.

programmes.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Race to Space"
programmes.desc: Superpower rivalries turn missile tech toward orbital supremacy, driving historic milestones from early satellite launches to landing on the moon.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programmes.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"
programmes.desc: During the Vietnam War, the USAF learned most pilot losses happened in their first 10 missions, leading to intense training that saves lives.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"
programmes.desc: At Fort Benning’s Army Combatives School, soldiers train in brutal hand-to-hand combat, learning real-world skills to fight and survive.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Stealth Submarines"
programmes.desc: Stealthy diesel submarines challenge nuclear subs. Inside a NATO exercise, we explore why they’re so deadly in the Norwegian fjords.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Heavy Armor"
programmes.desc: Tank crews train for deployment, mastering modern armored warfare where heavy tanks protect soldiers and dominate the battlefield.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Snipers"
programmes.desc: Silent and deadly, snipers train in elite schools, mastering long‑range weapons, stealth, and fieldcraft to become the battlefield’s ultimate asset.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Urban Warfare"
programmes.desc: Urban combat is brutal and unforgiving. At training sites worldwide, soldiers learn the tactics and teamwork needed to survive deadly city battles.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Fighter Pilots"
programmes.desc: New pilots train in air‑to‑air combat at an international exercise, mastering dogfighting and modern fighter jet technology.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Paratroopers"
programmes.desc: Airborne troops train as force multipliers, learning how paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to seize targets and launch ambushes.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Medics"
programmes.desc: Combat medics risk it all to save soldiers under fire. We join their training to see what it takes to save lives in the field.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Basic Training"
programmes.desc: Basic training transforms civilians into soldiers, sailors, and airmen through intense physical and psychological tests.

programmes.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Fitness"
programmes.desc: Combat fitness builds soldiers’ strength, endurance, and resilience, teaching skills crucial for survival, sometimes adapted for civilians.

programmes.title: War Factories S1 - "German Aviation"
programmes.desc: The untold secret story of war production that shaped the WWII, beginning with how the German aviation industry came to dominate the skies of Europe.

programmes.title: War Factories S1 - "Krupp"
programmes.desc: The story behind the Krupp company, who were responsible for the manufacture of two of Germany's most feared war products - the Panzer Tank and the U-boat.
